title: 救える畝、残せない畝
state: 排水は動く。新しい根は数日後に一部で確認。株数と収量をまだ保証しない。バルトが現地の知識を渡す。

scenes.description: Same garden at early light, two unequal panels: Kou examines yesterday's marked wilted plant still rooted, Elna behind him with empty watering can set down; closeup his cautious face and wet ground beginning to dry. No recovered jungle overnight.

dialogue: 抜いた株は、元には戻らん。
scenes.description: Wide Balt arrives on walking path in brown hat; separate closeup Balt observing marked plant; lower Kou listens. Balt is experienced and practical, not foolish. Dug plant from yesterday lies separately and is not replanted alive.

dialogue: この列だけ、別に記録する。
scenes.description: Overhead plot with one marked comparison strip and other rows; hand closeup tying plain twine marker without cutting roots; Elna looking from changed strip to remaining area. Plants vary realistically, no flashy transformation.

dialogue: 知らない数字は、空欄でいい。
分かったことだけ、残せ。
scenes.description: Two unequal panels: Kou writes simple marks and blank spaces in notebook at plot edge; closeup Elna reading over shoulder. A subtle empty translucent recording frame may hover but NO added visible text or numerical claims. Notebook has sketch marks only.

Time has advanced to day five. Three panels: same twine marker and modestly less wilted plant, gentle root inspection showing a few NEW white fine roots amid remaining damaged roots, Balt's restrained pleased expression. Recovery is partial, no instant glow or giant growth.

dialogue: こっちは、戻らないのね。
scenes.description: Large quiet panel of bare damaged strip where dead plants have been removed, Elna kneeling with sad face; lower Kou quietly placing tray to plan new sowing. Do not fill dead area with new mature plants.

dialogue: この葉は、若いうちが柔らかい。
切りやすい大きさが、欲しい。
scenes.description: Three unequal shots: Balt shows a surviving mature garden-leaf plant; Kou cuts usable leaves gently into clean shallow basket; Elna checks leaf size for kitchen. Source is surviving established plants, not seeds sown in this story.

dialogue: 食べる人まで、畑の続きだね。
scenes.description: Warm kitchen: basket passed from Kou's hands to Elna, narrow chopping closeup, large finished steaming dish at counter and their faces. Keep raw garden work off cooking surface. No magical buff display.
